ratio_definition.quote: "Leverage Ratio" means the ratio of Net Debt as of the end of any Relevant Period to Consolidated EBITDA in respect of such Relevant Period.

relevant_period.quote: "Relevant Period" means, as of any date, the four fiscal quarter period of the Company most recently ended on or as of such date.

evidence.quote: "Net Debt" means Debt for Borrowed Money less Cash and Cash Equivalents.

"Debt for Borrowed Money" of a person means all items that, in accordance with GAAP, would be classified as indebtedness on a Consolidated
balance sheet of such person other than any amounts which would be classified as indebtedness, in accordance with GAAP, which arise under any Hedge Agreements.

"Cash" means, at any time, cash as defined in the Audit
and Accounting Guides issued by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants of the United States of America (as amended from time to time) which includes as at the date of this Agreement currency on hand, demand deposits with financial
institutions and other similar deposit accounts.

"Cash Equivalents"
means, at any time, cash equivalents as defined in the Audit and Accounting Guides issued by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants of the United States of America (as amended from time to time) which includes as at the date of this
Agreement short term instruments having not more than three months to final maturity and highly liquid instruments readily convertible to known amounts of cash.

(e) extraordinary
or unusual losses deducted in calculating net income less extraordinary or unusual gains added in calculating net income, (f) all non-recurring non-cash

amendments_considered.what_changed: Amendment No. 1 (Aug 4, 2022): delayed leverage step-downs (4.50 through 6/30/2023, 4.25, 4.00, 3.75, then 3.50 after 9/30/2024).
Amendment No. 2 (Mar 23, 2023): Covenant Relief Period; 3.50 base, relief schedule 5.25 through 6/30/2023 stepping to 4.00 through 12/31/2024.
Amendment No. 3 (Mar 23, 2023): conformed-copy changes (Annex A); Section 5.03 and EBITDA definition read the same as Amendment No. 2 / original in the conformed copy.
Amendment No. 4 (Sep 19, 2023): restated Section 5.03 relief schedule 5.25 through 3/31/2024 stepping to 3.75 through 12/31/2025; Covenant Relief Period Termination Date extended to Mar 31, 2026.

draft_notes: Thresholds are the OPERATIVE timeline: each amendment's schedule applies from the first quarter-end test date after its date; earlier schedules are truncated there (see 'source'). Amendment effective dates assumed equal to their dated-as-of dates.
Original first test date assumed 2021-09-30 (agreement dated July 28, 2021).
Relief-period schedule treated as the base schedule (it applies unless the Company elects early termination). Qualifying Acquisition 3.75x step-up omitted per guide (optional event).

The 3.50 base and the 2025 levels may never have been tested under this agreement: a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated June 25, 2025 (accession 0000051253-26-000017, EX-10.1) appears to replace it. Not labeled here.

Denominator: Section uses 'Consolidated EBITDA'; the defined term is '"EBITDA" of a Person' applied to the Company on a consolidated basis. Term labeled 'Consolidated EBITDA'; verifier may prefer 'EBITDA'.
Consolidated EBITDA children are undefined line items (lowercase), not defined terms; 'less_labels' lists deducted items. No caps on addbacks.
